answers.question: Which professionals live in the state of Indiana or have done treatment on more than 2 treatments? List his or her id, last name and cell phone.
answers.generated_answer: SELECT professional_id, last_name, cell_number FROM professionals WHERE state = 'Indiana' OR professional_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT professional_id FROM treatments GROUP BY professional_id HAVING COUNT(treatment_id) > 2)

answers.question: Which dogs have not cost their owner more than 1000 for treatment ? List the dog names .
answers.generated_answer: SELECT DOG.NAME FROM DOGS INNER JOIN TREATMENTS ON DOGS.DOG_ID = TREATMENTS.DOG_ID INNER JOIN OWNERS ON DOGS.OWNER_ID = OWNERS.OWNER_ID GROUP BY DOGS.DOG_ID HAVING SUM(TREATMENTS.COST_OF_TREATMENT) <= 1000

answers.question: Give me the description of the treatment type whose total cost is the lowest.
answers.generated_answer: Select treatment_type_description from treatment_types join treatments on treatment_types.treatment_type_code = treatments.treatment_type_code group by treatment_type_description having sum(cost_of_treatment) = (select min(sum(cost_of_treatment)) from (select treatment_type_code, sum(cost_of_treatment) as total_cost from treatments group by treatment_type_code) as sub)

answers.question: Which professionals have operated a treatment that costs less than the average? Give me theor first names and last names.
answers.generated_answer: Select p.First_name, P.Last_name From Professionals P Where P.Professional_id in (Select T.Professional_id From Treatments T Where T.Cost_of_treatment < (Select avg(Cost_of_treatment) From Treatments))

answers.question: What are the cost and treatment type description of each treatment?
answers.generated_answer: SELECT ct.cost_of_treatment AS cost,tt.treatment_type_description FROM treatments ct,treatment_types tt WHERE ct.treatment_type_code = tt.treatment_type_code

answers.question: Which dogs are of the rarest breed? Show their names and treatment dates.
answers.generated_answer: SELECT d.name, t.date_of_treatment FROM dogs d JOIN treatments t ON d.dog_id = t.dog_id JOIN breeds b ON d.breed_code = b.breed_code WHERE b.breed_code = ( SELECT breed_code FROM breeds GROUP BY breed_code HAVING COUNT(*) = MIN(COUNT(*)) )

answers.question: Find the first names of owners living in Virginia and the names of dogs they own.
answers.generated_answer: SELECT DISTINCT FIRST_NAME FROM OWNERS WHERE STATE = 'VA'

answers.question: List the last name of the owner owning the youngest dog.
answers.generated_answer: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM owners WHERE owner_id = (SELECT MIN(age) FROM dogs)

answers.question: Count the number of dogs that went through a treatment.
answers.generated_answer: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.dog_id) FROM dogs d INNER JOIN treatments t ON d.dog_id = t.dog_id

answers.question: Find the role, street, city and state of the professionals living in a city that contains the substring 'West'.
answers.generated_answer: SELECT role_code, street, city, state FROM professionals WHERE city LIKE '%West%'
